purpose: Provide the canonical executable R0 YYZ qualification source, selected scientific assets, two-interval source-to-result reference and leaf-level cross-implementation difference report while preserving the 30 second architecture example as target-pending.

provenance.notes: The repository owner accepted the recommended R0 qualification choices and requested subsequent current-R0 recommendations to be accepted and recorded by default. The current two-interval lookup-composed mission is therefore canonical only for the declared fixture-local qualification scope. The 00A 30 second, 100 Hz author example remains a separately identified target profile with no scientific verdict contribution. Product schemas, loaders, Compiler, Session and durable evidence remain locked.

expected_facts.claim: The executable two-interval R0 qualification profile and the 30 second target architecture profile retain separate identities, values, status and verdict authority.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Profile ids, status and target scientific_verdict_contribution are exact.

expected_facts.claim: The canonical qualification initial condition, clock, frames, configuration, twelve component identities and seven selected asset families resolve exactly to the executable mission composition inputs.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Identity, path, structure and selected input values are exact against the accepted source cases.

expected_facts.claim: The R0 source resolves to machine-valid step trace, atomic rigid/mass commits, committed terminal observation and three structured precommit failure projections with rollback proof.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Ordering, tick, commit, identity, diagnostic linkage and rollback fields are exact; scientific numeric leaves use the declared field policy.

expected_facts.claim: Independent Python and C++17 implementations reproduce three committed samples, two causal intervals, fourth-order convergence and the tick-2 downrange completion result.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Formula/state fields use 2e-12 absolute plus relative bounds, convergence ratios also permit 5e-4 absolute difference and every ratio remains at least 12; categorical terminal fields are exact.

expected_facts.claim: Every C++ probe leaf has an explicit semantic path, expected value, observed value, tolerance policy, allowed bound or exact rule, absolute difference when numeric and passing verdict.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: The report must cover the complete probe tree with zero failed fields and must preserve the frozen formula and convergence tolerances exactly.

acceptance: One command resolves the canonical source and assets, regenerates the independent mission reference, runs the C++17 probe and verifies every reported field
The qualification source maps to executable step, observation, terminal and diagnostic facts while the target architecture profile remains target-pending
Six canonical boundary mutations plus the inherited fourteen input cases, ten scientific/time mutations and three structured diagnostics are rejected
The bundle introduces no product schema, loader, Compiler, Session or durable evidence capability
